title: How Jack Friks got 100k+ app downloads with zero ads using organic short-form media
summary: Jack Friks explains how he drove 100,000+ free downloads to his mobile app by posting non-salesy short-form content on Instagram and TikTok, with the call to action only in the caption and pinned comment. He also covers validating ideas through organic media before building, and how this led him to build Post Bridge to schedule and template content at scale.

principles.text: Don't make the content an ad. Keep the video related to your niche and put the call to action only in the caption and pinned comment.
principles.quote: if you make it an ad and you're doing organic you're going to get like you're going to get a 100 200 views every single time the less call to action you have even if you have none you're going to perform better on the views

principles.text: Find formats by scrolling your niche: save posts that went viral, ask why they worked, and replicate the replicable ones as templates.
principles.quote: I just find things that have went viral and I kind of think about why like what drove these comments why did people like the video why did they watch the whole thing is this can this be replicated into a format

principles.text: Distribution is a volume game: output is limited by how many videos you can make and how many warmed-up accounts you have.
principles.quote: the limit is how much videos are you able to create and how many accounts you have that are warmed up that you can post to and like that's the only real factors that I think stop anyone from like scaling further

principles.text: Validate demand with organic content before building: if a pain point can't go viral organically, it's probably not a good business.
principles.quote: if you can't get a a Content format to go viral that has a a problem with your product as the solution then it's probably not a good business to build

principles.text: Build tools that solve your own problem; that's how his apps and Post Bridge came about, and it gave a high hit rate.
principles.quote: the main two ideas I had both worked out pretty well like the batting average of like idea to actually making money has been really high just following that like simple curve of like just building what I need for myself

principles.text: Post the same media to every channel, but optimize for the one where your audience is and where you scroll; extra channels are free reach.
principles.quote: I Target Instagram optimize for Instagram I scroll on Instagram if I'm going to find formats and then I just post a Tik Tok for like just extra views whatever extra reach happens
